text:
ITEM 1 | Pale green, crisp-looking leafy greens with darker green edges and pale yellow-green ribbed leaf sections, torn into irregular pieces about 2-5 cm long, with a creamy light-yellow coating clinging to the leaves; covers roughly 35% of the plate, piled up to about 2 cm high in the right-center area, no visible breading or char | 110

ITEM 2 | Thin, pale ivory-to-light-tan flakes or shavings, slightly curled and semi-translucent edges, scattered over the top of the greens, dry-looking with a faint sheen, each shaving about 2-4 cm across | 12

ITEM 3 | Creamy, pale yellow dressing-like coating with a glossy, slightly wet sheen, visible as a thin film coating and pooling between the leaves, no distinct blob, spread across the greens | 15

ITEM 4 | Small, pale yellow-tan crumbly chunk, about 1.5 cm across, with a dry, slightly granular surface, sitting at the lower edge of the greens on the plate | 5
